summary: Fitzroy and Brunswick resident, former medical equipment technician, IT support professional, strong advocate for social justice and egalitarianism, critical of exclusivity in hiring practices, interested in scientific rigor and peer review, enjoys travel and cultural experiences, has a nuanced understanding of political and social issues, engages in discussions about technology and user experience, values community and helping others, has a background in academic research, and expresses a strong opinion on the importance of effective communication and accessibility in technology.
